task.title: Nested transactional undo history
task.specification: config={initial:object,limit:integer 1..4}. Events set={type:'set',key,value}, delete={type:'delete',key}, or {type:'begin'|'commit'|'cancel'|'undo'|'redo'}. Maintain document, bounded undo/redo histories and nested group stack. Begin saves the current document. Edits inside groups change the document without history entries. Commit closes the innermost group; only an outermost commit whose final document differs from its saved start records that start in undo and clears redo. Cancel restores and closes the innermost group's start, without recording history. A changed edit outside groups records its pre-edit document in undo and clears redo. No-op edits and empty/no-op groups preserve redo. Undo/redo during a group are ignored; otherwise move current document to the opposite history and restore the most recent source entry. Retain at most limit entries in each history, dropping oldest. Commit/cancel without a group and unavailable undo/redo are ignored. Output {document,canUndo:boolean,canRedo:boolean,depth:integer}; availability booleans are false while a group is open. Deep object equality ignores key order. Return one output per event. State is opaque JSON, initially null. Output objects have exactly the documented keys; object key order is irrelevant, array order is significant. IDs are nonempty ASCII strings. Values are JSON scalars unless stated otherwise. Numeric values and intermediate arithmetic are safe integers; integral JSON notations such as 1 and 1.0 denote the same number, while booleans are distinct. Strings contain Unicode scalar values without unpaired surrogates. Inputs have at most 48 events and eight simultaneous identities. Ordinary instances vary values; boundary instances emphasize empty/disabled/equality/no-op states; adversarial instances reorder callbacks and interleave edits; shift instances use longer traces/more identities within the same rules. These tasks test controller state/effects only, not visual quality, browser integration or screen-reader usability.

matchedCard.label: Canal locks
matchedCard.relation: Passage between regions at different levels proceeds through an intermediate chamber. The chamber matches the entrance level before admission, is isolated while its level changes, and matches the departure level before release.
assumptions: The chamber can be isolated from each neighboring region.
Level differences and the states of the gates are observable.
matchedCard.boundary: Simultaneous open connections bypass the intermediate isolation. An unobserved level difference does not establish that opening a gate is appropriate.
matchedCard.source_fact: USACE describes raising and lowering vessels by closing lock gates, filling or emptying the chamber, and opening the gates after levels equalize.

shuffledCard.label: Astronomical interferometry
shuffledCard.relation: Separated measurements can be combined after their relative arrival paths are aligned. Different separations and orientations contribute different spatial information; fine detail and broad structure require complementary measurement coverage.
assumptions: The measurements concern a compatible signal and maintain the needed relative alignment.
The range of separations and orientations samples the structure being reconstructed.
shuffledCard.boundary: A longer separation does not supply missing measurement orientations or increase the collecting area by the same factor. Misaligned signals need not combine into an accurate reconstruction.
shuffledCard.source_fact: ESO describes compensating path delays in interferometry and reconstructing images from telescope baselines of different lengths and orientations, distinguishing resolution from collected light.

initial.explanation: The conditional rule is: after the first event, redo is unavailable whenever the initial redo history is empty. More generally, redo changes only through successful undo/redo or changed history-recording edits; no-op edits, group operations, and unavailable commands preserve it. I implement full nested transactional history semantics.
initial.mapping: Document d, undo u, redo r, and group stack g are the target variables. Each group stores its saved document. History arrays store snapshots oldest-to-newest.
initial.assumptions: Inputs are valid under the stated contract. Document values are plain objects with scalar values, and JSON parsing has already normalized equivalent numeric forms.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const x of output){if(!x||typeof x!=="object"||typeof x.canUndo!=="boolean"||typeof x.canRedo!=="boolean"||!Number.isInteger(x.depth)||x.depth<0||!x.document||Array.isArray(x.document))return false}return output.length===0||output[0].canRedo===false}
initial.program: function solve({config,state,event}){function cp(x){const y={};for(const k in x)y[k]=x[k];return y}function eq(a,b){const ak=Object.keys(a),bk=Object.keys(b);if(ak.length!==bk.length)return false;for(const k of ak)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,k)||a[k]!==b[k])return false;return true}function trim(a){while(a.length>config.limit)a.shift()}let s=state;if(!s)s={d:cp(config.initial),u:[],r:[],g:[]};const e=event,t=e.type;if(t==='begin')s.g.push(cp(s.d));else if(t==='set'||t==='delete'){let n=cp(s.d),has=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(n,e.key);if(t==='set')n[e.key]=e.value;else if(has)delete n[e.key];if(!eq(n,s.d)){if(!s.g.length){s.u.push(cp(s.d));trim(s.u);s.r=[]}s.d=n}}else if(t==='commit'&&s.g.length){let old=s.g.pop();if(!s.g.length&&!eq(old,s.d)){s.u.push(old);trim(s.u);s.r=[]}}else if(t==='cancel'&&s.g.length)s.d=s.g.pop();else if(!s.g.length&&t==='undo'&&s.u.length){s.r.push(cp(s.d));trim(s.r);s.d=s.u.pop()}else if(!s.g.length&&t==='redo'&&s.r.length){s.u.push(cp(s.d));trim(s.u);s.d=s.r.pop()}return{state:s,output:{document:cp(s.d),canUndo:!s.g.length&&s.u.length>0,canRedo:!s.g.length&&s.r.length>0,depth:s.g.length}}}

final.explanation: Changed edits outside groups create bounded undo entries and clear redo. Group edits remain unrecorded; outermost commit records only a changed transaction, while cancel restores its snapshot. Undo and redo exchange snapshots only when available and never operate inside groups. No-op operations preserve histories.
final.program: function solve({config,state,event}){function copy(o){var n=Object.create(null),ks=Object.keys(o);for(var i=0;i<ks.length;i++)n[ks[i]]=o[ks[i]];return n}function same(a,b){var ak=Object.keys(a),bk=Object.keys(b);if(ak.length!==bk.length)return false;for(var i=0;i<ak.length;i++){var k=ak[i];if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,k)||a[k]!==b[k])return false}return true}function bound(a){while(a.length>config.limit)a.shift()}var s=state;if(s===null){s={d:copy(config.initial),u:[],r:[],g:[]}}var e=event,t=e.type;if(t==='begin'){s.g.push(copy(s.d))}else if(t==='set'||t==='delete'){var n=copy(s.d),k=e.key,has=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(n,k);if(t==='set')n[k]=e.value;else if(has)delete n[k];if(!same(n,s.d)){if(s.g.length===0){s.u.push(copy(s.d));bound(s.u);s.r=[]}s.d=n}}else if(t==='commit'&&s.g.length){var old=s.g.pop();if(s.g.length===0&&!same(old,s.d)){s.u.push(old);bound(s.u);s.r=[]}}else if(t==='cancel'&&s.g.length){s.d=s.g.pop()}else if(t==='undo'&&s.g.length===0&&s.u.length){s.r.push(copy(s.d));bound(s.r);s.d=s.u.pop()}else if(t==='redo'&&s.g.length===0&&s.r.length){s.u.push(copy(s.d));bound(s.u);s.d=s.r.pop()}return{state:s,output:{document:copy(s.d),canUndo:s.g.length===0&&s.u.length>0,canRedo:s.g.length===0&&s.r.length>0,depth:s.g.length}}}

initial.explanation: Use a transactional document controller: edits inside groups are isolated from history, while completed outermost changes and standalone edits create bounded undo entries. Undo and redo exchange current documents between bounded stacks.
initial.mapping: Document is the mutable object; undo and redo are ordered document snapshots; group starts are nested transaction checkpoints. A commit records only a changed outermost transaction, while cancel restores its checkpoint.
initial.assumptions: Inputs are valid according to the public contract. Document keys are ordinary own properties, and JSON deep equality is determined recursively without considering object key order.
initial.program: function solve({config,state,event}){const cp=x=>{if(x===null||typeof x!=='object')return x;if(Array.isArray(x))return x.map(cp);let y={};for(const k of Object.keys(x))y[k]=cp(x[k]);return y};const eq=(a,b)=>{if(a===b)return true;if(typeof a!==typeof b||a===null||b===null||typeof a!=='object')return false;if(Array.isArray(a)||Array.isArray(b)){if(!Array.isArray(a)||!Array.isArray(b)||a.length!==b.length)return false;for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(!eq(a[i],b[i]))return false;return true}let ak=Object.keys(a),bk=Object.keys(b);if(ak.length!==bk.length)return false;for(const k of ak)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,k)||!eq(a[k],b[k]))return false;return true};let s=state||{d:cp(config.initial),u:[],r:[],g:[],n:config.limit};const add=(a,v)=>{a.push(cp(v));while(a.length>s.n)a.shift()};const changed=()=>{let e=event,t=e.type;if(t==='set'){if(!eq(s.d[e.key],e.value)||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.d,e.key)){if(!s.g.length)add(s.u,s.d);s.r=[];s.d[e.key]=cp(e.value)}}else if(t==='delete'&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.d,e.key)){if(!s.g.length)add(s.u,s.d);s.r=[];delete s.d[e.key]}};if(event.type==='begin')s.g.push(cp(s.d));else if(event.type==='commit'&&s.g.length){let start=s.g.pop();if(!s.g.length&&!eq(start,s.d)){add(s.u,start);s.r=[]}}else if(event.type==='cancel'&&s.g.length)s.d=s.g.pop();else if(event.type==='undo'&&!s.g.length&&s.u.length){add(s.r,s.d);s.d=s.u.pop()}else if(event.type==='redo'&&!s.g.length&&s.r.length){add(s.u,s.d);s.d=s.r.pop()}else if(event.type==='set'||event.type==='delete')changed();return{state:s,output:{document:cp(s.d),canUndo:!s.g.length&&s.u.length>0,canRedo:!s.g.length&&s.r.length>0,depth:s.g.length}}}

final.explanation: Maintains a cloned document, bounded undo/redo stacks, and nested transaction checkpoints. Only standalone changes and changed outermost commits affect history; edits within open groups defer redo invalidation until a changed outermost commit. No-op operations preserve histories, while undo/redo exchange snapshots and are disabled during groups.
final.program: function solve({config,state,event}){const clone=x=>{if(!x||typeof x!=='object')return x;if(Array.isArray(x))return x.map(clone);const y={};for(const k of Object.keys(x))y[k]=clone(x[k]);return y};const equal=(a,b)=>{if(a===b)return true;if(typeof a!==typeof b||a===null||b===null)return false;if(Array.isArray(a)||Array.isArray(b)){if(!Array.isArray(a)||!Array.isArray(b)||a.length!==b.length)return false;for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(!equal(a[i],b[i]))return false;return true}const ak=Object.keys(a),bk=Object.keys(b);if(ak.length!==bk.length)return false;for(const k of ak)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,k)||!equal(a[k],b[k]))return false;return true};let s=state;if(!s)s={d:clone(config.initial),u:[],r:[],g:[],n:config.limit};const put=(a,v)=>{a.push(clone(v));if(a.length>s.n)a.shift()};const has=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty;const t=event.type;if(t==='begin')s.g.push(clone(s.d));else if(t==='commit'&&s.g.length){const start=s.g.pop();if(!s.g.length&&!equal(start,s.d)){put(s.u,start);s.r=[]}}else if(t==='cancel'&&s.g.length)s.d=s.g.pop();else if(t==='undo'&&!s.g.length&&s.u.length){put(s.r,s.d);s.d=s.u.pop()}else if(t==='redo'&&!s.g.length&&s.r.length){put(s.u,s.d);s.d=s.r.pop()}else if(t==='set'||t==='delete'){let changed=false;if(t==='set')changed=!has.call(s.d,event.key)||!equal(s.d[event.key],event.value);else changed=has.call(s.d,event.key);if(changed){if(!s.g.length){put(s.u,s.d);s.r=[]}if(t==='set')s.d[event.key]=clone(event.value);else delete s.d[event.key]}}return{state:s,output:{document:clone(s.d),canUndo:!s.g.length&&s.u.length>0,canRedo:!s.g.length&&s.r.length>0,depth:s.g.length}}}

initial.explanation: Use the transactional history rule directly: edits outside groups create bounded undo entries; grouped edits defer history until an outermost commit, while cancel restores the saved document. Undo/redo exchange current documents between bounded stacks and are disabled inside groups.
initial.mapping: The optional source rule maps alignment to preserving document snapshots and history ordering; however, astronomical interferometry is not relevant to this state-transition contract, so no outside assumptions are used.
initial.assumptions: Documents contain JSON-compatible object data and event values are JSON scalars as specified. State is represented by the current document, undo/redo arrays, group-start array, and configured limit.

final.explanation: Maintains immutable document snapshots, bounded undo/redo stacks, and nested transaction starts. Edits inside groups alter only the document; outermost commits record a changed transaction, while cancel restores its start. No-op operations preserve history, and undo/redo exchange snapshots only outside groups. Object comparison is deep and key-order independent.
